claim: Hashes every selected APK byte on this device
sandbox: Select a deterministic signed APK fixture and assert its complete known SHA-256 in the evidence dialog

claim: Cryptographically verifies APK v1, v2, and v3 signatures and v3 signer lineage on this device
where: Landing workflow, record card, evidence dialog, README
sandbox: Select Android apksig's v1/v2/v3 fixture with a three-certificate lineage; assert every scheme and lineage node is verified

claim: Verifies APK v1/JAR signers
sandbox: Select Android apksig's v1-only RSA fixture and assert a verified v1 signer

claim: Rejects an APK when signed content has changed
sandbox: Flip one byte in a stored entry of a valid v1/v2/v3 APK and assert cryptographic verification rejects it

claim: Rejects a malformed v3 signing-certificate lineage
sandbox: Select Android apksig's invalid-lineage fixture and assert that the verified block is still rejected

claim: Extracts package name, version name, and version code from AndroidManifest.xml
where: Landing workflow, record card, evidence dialog, README
sandbox: Select the signed lineage fixture and assert package android.appsecurity.cts.tinyapp, version 1.0, and version code 10

claim: Warns when a verified APK version code is below the newest recorded version for that package
sandbox: Record a verified package at version code 11, select its verified version-code-10 APK, and assert the incompatible downgrade warning

claim: Warns when a package signer is outside the previously verified signer lineage
sandbox: Record a verified package with an unrelated prior signer, select its signed APK, and assert the signer-change warning

claim: Requires a signed APK archive containing compiled AndroidManifest.xml
where: Landing workflow, record dialog, Terms, README
sandbox: Select non-ZIP bytes and an inconsistent local/central ZIP entry; assert both are rejected

claim: Exports password-encrypted records and optional saved APK copies
where: Landing facts and workflow, export dialog, README
sandbox: Export a saved signed APK; assert plaintext package data is absent and the supplied password opens it with matching hash, signature, identity, and signer

claim: The restore-kit password is never stored
sandbox: Export with a unique password and search localStorage, sessionStorage, and Cache Storage for it

claim: Records and optional APK copies are stored on this device
sandbox: Record a real fixture, reload, and assert it persists only in the real local namespace

claim: Remove erases a record and its saved APK copy
sandbox: Save a fixture, prove metadata and bytes exist, remove it, then assert the real record list and IndexedDB store are empty

claim: Demo data is separate and erased when leaving demo mode
sandbox: Add demo metadata and bytes, choose Start for real, then assert the demo localStorage key and IndexedDB database are absent

claim: The demo needs no account and makes no automatic third-party requests
sandbox: Run and reset demo while recording requests; assert no account input and only the product origin

claim: Selected APK files are never uploaded
sandbox: From /demo, select and fully verify a genuine signed APK fixture while recording every request; assert only product-origin GET requests occur, no request body contains APK bytes, no api.github.com request occurs, and no console or page error is emitted

claim: Demo reloads offline after the first visit
sandbox: Load /demo, disable the browser HTTP cache, go offline, reload, and assert the shell and sample records render

claim: APK signature checks work offline after the first visit
sandbox: Load the app once, go offline, select the v1-only signed fixture, and assert its signer verifies

claim: The landing page links directly to the v0.4.0 APK, AAB, and SHA256SUMS assets
sandbox: Assert deterministic GitHub release-asset URLs and that page load makes no GitHub API request

claim: A valid $12 one-time Locker Plus license adds private device labels and can be restored on another device
where: Landing paid tier, evidence dialog, Privacy, Terms, README
sandbox: Mock a valid Sociobot verdict, paste a license, assert the namespaced token and daily verdict cache, then save and persist a device label

claim: Locker Plus costs $12 once and uses the Sociobot hosted checkout
sandbox: Assert the exact price and checkout URL, then require an HTTP redirect to a Dodo hosted checkout session
